visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a vertical split-screen layout. The top half shows a mobile game lobby with various circular skill icons and a glowing purple orb. The bottom half features a young woman with long, straight dark brown hair, wearing a light beige sleeveless tank top, sitting in a pink and white ergonomic gaming chair. She is holding a smartphone horizontally and smiling as she prepares to play. The background behind her is a simple indoor room with a purple wall. (2) The visual focus shifts to intense gameplay within a fantasy-themed MOBA arena. High-energy battle animations with colorful particle effects are visible on the top and center of the screen. The streamer's face is shown in a smaller square window at the top right; she appears highly focused, with her mouth agape in reaction to the action. Large, stylized variety text overlays in yellow and white flash across the screen to emphasize game milestones. (3) Upon achieving victory, a 'Victory' banner appears. The streamer raises her arms in a celebratory gesture, smiling broadly toward the camera. The screen then transitions to a detailed post-game statistics menu with several character portraits and performance scores. She points at the screen while continuing her enthusiastic commentary, her expressions remaining animated and high-energy until the video ends.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A female voice begins with high energy and a fast speech rate, laughing as she proposes a bet about eating a phone. An upbeat electronic pop BGM starts with a clear drum beat and bright synth tones. Frequent digital UI clicks and 'pop' sound effects punctuate the variety text reveals. (2) Vocal volume increases significantly, featuring high-pitched shouts and vocal strain as the battle gameplay intensifies. Loud, synthesized combat sound effects like energy explosions and metallic impacts overlap with the game announcer's 'Triple Kill' and 'Ace' callouts. The music maintains a driving, high-tempo rhythm. (3) The music transitions into a lighter, triumphant orchestral fanfare for the victory screen. The female voice returns to a conversational yet still highly animated tone, discussing the game's score system. Strategic 'ding' sound effects accompany the display of points on the statistics menu. The overall mix is dense but clear.
